name: Cururu: Whispers of the Enchanted Forest
detailed_description:
Cururu: Whispers of the Enchanted Forest

A world where nature speaks through ancient spirits.

After choices that led to humanity’s extinction, nature has risen once more.
Explore a post-apocalyptic Brazil where animals evolved and built a new civilization using technologies that grow from the earth. In this Naturepunk world, embark on a journey of discovery and salvation as Cururu, a young frog guided by ancestral spirits and gifted with sacred water powers capable of cleansing corruption from a world on the brink.

Cururu: Whispers of the Enchanted Forest is a 2D Metroidvania platformer with a strong narrative focus, hand-crafted visuals, and deep roots in Brazilian culture. Explore reimagined biomes, solve nature-based puzzles, evolve your abilities, confront creatures inspired by folklore, and unlock new paths using the purifying power of water.

Highlights

Explore a reimagined Brazil
Travel through biomes inspired by the Atlantic Forest, the Amazon, the Cerrado, and more — accompanied by an organic soundtrack in a rich Naturepunk setting.

Water that shapes the world
Wield the power of your water staff to overcome physical and spiritual challenges, cleanse corruption, interact with the environment, and free corrupted spirits.

Folklore-inspired allies and enemies
Encounter mythological figures like Boitatá, Saci Pererê, and Curupira, and meet animals who will guide your path.

Symbolic progression
Grow by collecting seeds, fruits, and magical talismans that tell the story of this world and connect you to the forgotten gods of Brazil.

A unique artistic identity
Hand-drawn illustrations and fluid animation inspired by modern cartoons and regional art styles.

A spiritual narrative
A tale of healing, connection, and resistance — layered with poetic storytelling for players of all ages.
